topic: Lateral stability: forces and Moments, effect of wing dihedral, effects of slide slip, induced roll and induced yaw.
syllabus_extract: Lateral stability: forces and Moments, effect of wing dihedral, effects of slide slip, induced roll and induced yaw. Factors effecting lateral stability. Wing sweepback effect. Dihedral effect
specific_objectives: 6.1.4.1 Trainee will be able to describe aircraft stability in all the three axis.

practical: Review of Lateral Stability concepts using PPT diagrams; Instructor supervision required for diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: What are the three axes of an aircraft?
Define lateral stability in your own words.
Which axis does lateral stability primarily control?

Forces and Moments involved

summary_questions: Explain how wing dihedral contributes to lateral stability.
Describe the relationship between sideslip and induced roll.
How does wing sweepback affect lateral stability?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note comparing the effects of dihedral and sweepback on lateral stability, referencing concepts from LP 28.
